name: Insulation
description: Armor's protection against heat and cold.

pages.title: Insulation
pages.text:
**Insulation** is the cold or heat resistance on armor. It slows how fast your body temperature drifts.\
\
Leather armor and furs have some. A **Sewing Table** sews insulators such as Goat Fur (cold), Rabbit Hide or Hoglin Hide (heat) onto any armor. Iron, diamond and netherite armor have none of their own. Hover a piece to read its insulation.
